passages.provision_quote: “assault weapon” also means any of the following: (1) A semiautomatic, centerfire rifle that does not have a fixed magazine but has any one of the following: (A) A pistol grip that protrudes conspicuously beneath the action of the weapon.
passages.note: Bill text redefines “assault weapon” to add more semiautomatic rifles/pistols lacking a fixed magazine, extending the existing ban while leaving other firearms untouched.
McGuire is listed among the Ayes on SB 880's Senate floor passage, 24-14.

rows.reasoning: McGuire voted Aye on SB 880 (2015-2016), which amends Penal Code Section 30515 to redefine “assault weapon” to include additional semiautomatic centerfire rifles and pistols lacking a fixed magazine, extending the state's existing assault-weapons ban to more weapons while leaving other firearms untouched, matching rung 2's “Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms.”
